alignment.note: the reproduction is this far from where the original has the same floor

P1.reason: The overall arrangement matches: two octagonal halves around a north-south spine, the ring corridors, the west wing and the NE annex with its stairs. Some of the ways between areas differ. The original's spine is split into separate blocks with a yellow-trimmed middle section, and the reproduction's is one unbroken strip. The original's func_ladders at the spine's south end (10, 11) are gone and plain func_walls stand there instead. At starts 2, 3 and 4 the views show a wall or pillar where the original is open, and an opening where the original faces a wall, so the local connections around those starts are not the same.

P2.reason: The measured floor overlap is 0.942 with no offset, well over 0.70. On the plans, the octagons, ring corridors, west wing, spine length and annex all sit in place at the original's size, within about 10%. The NE annex's diagonal edge and the strips beside the spine differ only slightly.

P3.reason: The section mostly agrees: floors at 0, 160, 320 and 512, the same ceiling profile and the notch on the right. The storeys disagree, though. The top cut's highest floor is 560 against the original's 542, and the 372 cut's is 336 against 371, so some ledges or tops sit at different heights. The inner faces of the two halves at the top level are drawn as sloped tan surfaces in the reproduction, where the original's are flat grey. The lower-left floor has an extra step near x -1400 that the original lacks, and a func_illusionary box spans z 320 to 512 over the centre where the original has none.

P4.reason: All 58 point entities match within 64 units (share 1.0). The brush entities that govern movement do not. The original's func_ladders 10 and 11 at the spine's south end are missing, replaced by func_walls. The original's trigger_multiples 92 and 93 beside the west func_doors are absent from the reproduction's z 228 storey. There is also an added func_illusionary over the centre.

P5.reason: Most surfaces wear the original's concrete wall, shelf-window and yellow trim textures (starts 1, 5, 6 and 7 match). At start 8 the corridor floor is grey where the original's is brown tile, and the ceiling lamp's face is a different, garbled texture. At start 3 the orange ceiling trim is missing. On the plan, the central hexagonal areas show tan or yellow instead of the original's dark grey.

P6.reason: Starts 5, 6 and 7 are clearly brighter than the original's dim views, and start 8's lamp is much brighter. Light entities are rearranged. The original's cluster of lights in the NE annex (17, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 25, 27) is cut down to a few, while new lights (39 to 44) sit east of the main hall. The section's light is at about z 384 instead of the original's 280. An added info_texlights and info_minlights change the overall lighting.

P7.reason: The central corridor, shelf windows and ring corridors are there. Several distinctive features are not. The four solid pillars in the octagon rooms appear only as outline squares, moved toward the spine. The spine's separate blocks and yellow-trimmed middle are lost. The thin diagonal walls became thick bevelled rails with lamp fixtures. The corridor's lamp at start 8 is a different fixture.

P8.reason: The check reports no errors, and the walk test finds nothing unreached in the reproduction (the original has 3 unreached). It compiles and every start reaches every item on foot.

P9.reason: Starts 1, 5, 6, 7 and 8 are recognisably the same place, allowing for brighter light and the start 8 floor and lamp. Starts 2, 3 and 4 are not. At start 2 a pillar or wall fills the left half. At start 3 a near wall blocks the right side, where the original shows the shelf windows going around a corner. At start 4 the original faces a bare wall close up, and the reproduction shows a shelf window.
